text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following the incident at summer camp, Admire Vega has been having frequent nightmares.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In her dreams, her sister chides her for enjoying races and forgetting to atone for the past.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So, she swears to never race for herself again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega heads for the Kikuka Sho bearing the sad and difficult decision she's made.
